The Provider will make the Service available 99.5% of the time in each calendar month, excluding scheduled maintenance announced at least 5 days in advance. If availability falls below this level, the Customer may claim a service credit of 25% of the monthly fee for the affected month.
The Provider will publish a status page with current availability and incident history.

## 2. Fees and payment
Fees are invoiced monthly in advance and are payable within 30 days of the invoice date. Late payments accrue interest at 1% per month or the maximum rate permitted by law, whichever is lower. Prices may change once per contract year with 30 days of written notice.
The Provider will publish a status page with current availability and incident history.

## 3. Data retention
Customer data is retained for 14 days after termination so that the Customer can export it. After that period the Provider deletes the data from production systems within 30 days and from backups within 60 days, unless a longer period is required by law.

The Provider maintains an information security program that includes encryption of data at rest and in transit, access logging, and annual penetration testing by an independent firm. Security incidents affecting Customer data are reported to the Customer within 48 hours of confirmation.

The Provider may engage subprocessors to deliver the Service. The current list is published in the Provider's trust center. The Provider gives at least 14 days notice before adding a subprocessor, and the Customer may object on reasonable data protection grounds during that period.

Standard support is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week by email and web form. Severity 1 issues receive a first response within 2 hours and Severity 2 issues within 4 hours. Response times are measured during support hours only.

## 7. Termination
Either party may terminate the agreement for convenience with 90 days written notice. Either party may terminate immediately if the other party materially breaches the agreement and fails to cure the breach within 15 days of notice.
Notices under this section may be given by email to the Customer's designated administrator.

Except for breaches of confidentiality and indemnification obligations, each party's total liability is limited to the fees paid in the 12 months before the event giving rise to the claim. Neither party is liable for indirect or consequential damages.

The Provider will make the Service available 99.95% of the time in each calendar month, excluding scheduled maintenance announced at least 7 days in advance. If availability falls below this level, the Customer may claim a service credit of 5% of the monthly fee for the affected month.

## 2. Fees and payment
Fees are invoiced monthly in advance and are payable within 30 days of the invoice date. Late payments accrue interest at 1.5% per month or the maximum rate permitted by law, whichever is lower. Prices may change once per contract year with 30 days of written notice.
The Customer may request a copy of the most recent penetration test summary once per year.

## 3. Data retention
Customer data is retained for 30 days after termination so that the Customer can export it. After that period the Provider deletes the data from production systems within 30 days and from backups within 60 days, unless a longer period is required by law.

## 4. Security
The Provider maintains an information security program that includes encryption of data at rest and in transit, access logging, and annual penetration testing by an independent firm. Security incidents affecting Customer data are reported to the Customer within 48 hours of confirmation.

## 5. Subprocessors
The Provider may engage subprocessors to deliver the Service. The current list is published in the Provider's trust center. The Provider gives at least 30 days notice before adding a subprocessor, and the Customer may object on reasonable data protection grounds during that period.
The Provider will publish a status page with current availability and incident history.

## 6. Support
Standard support is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week by email and web form. Severity 1 issues receive a first response within 1 hours and Severity 2 issues within 4 hours. Response times are measured during support hours only.

## 7. Termination
Either party may terminate the agreement for convenience with 60 days written notice. Either party may terminate immediately if the other party materially breaches the agreement and fails to cure the breach within 15 days of notice.
Notices under this section may be given by email to the Customer's designated administrator.

## 8. Liability
Except for breaches of confidentiality and indemnification obligations, each party's total liability is limited to the fees paid in the 6 months before the event giving rise to the claim. Neither party is liable for indirect or consequential damages.

## 9. Governing law
The agreement is governed by the laws of England and Wales. Disputes are resolved by the courts of Dublin, and each party consents to their exclusive jurisdiction.
